title: Payg'ambar xonadonidagi ismli zot
intro: Oxirgi xabarchining xonadonida shaxsiy hikoyasi barcha imonlilar uchun ilohiy saboq bo'lgan bir ruh yashagan. Bu shaxsning hayoti ijtimoiy urf-odatlarni abadiy o'zgartirgan, imonning oila va mansublikni qanday belgilashida chuqur o'zgarishni ko'rsatgan o'zgaruvchan buyruq bilan chambarchas bog'liq edi.
clues: Mening ismim bir vaqtlar olijanob nasl bilan bog'liq edi, ammo keyinchalik yuqori haqiqat imonning haqiqiy rishtalarini aniqlab berdi.
Men Alloh va Uning elchisi tomonidan buyuk ne'matga sazovor bo'ldim, bu ne'mat Kitobda ochiqchasiga e'lon qilingan edi.
Oilaviy hayotim asrab olingan munosabatlar haqidagi tasavvurni abadiy o'zgartiradigan muhim sinovga aylandi.
Men shaxsiy sinovlarim tufayli Payg'ambarga men ketganimdan keyin bir ayolga uylanishga ruxsat beruvchi ilohiy amrga olib kelgan odam edim.
Mening hikoyam orqali biologik va tanlangan oila o'rtasidagi farq barcha avlodlar uchun aniq ko'rsatildi.
Men tengdoshlarim orasida oxirgi vahiyda payg'ambar sifatida emas, balki sinovdan o'tgan va sharaflangan banda sifatida aniq ko'rsatilgan yagona odamman.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
